experiment: Two full-scale three-span continuous roof purlin assemblies (one 8 in. Z purlin system and one 7 in. C purlin system, each with two purlin lines and through-fastened metal roof deck) were loaded to failure with simulated gravity load in a vacuum chamber while strain gages, support load cells, potentiometers and optical deflection targets were read at each load increment.
title: Full-Scale Vacuum-Chamber Gravity Load Tests of Z and C Purlin Roof Systems

variables.definition: Sequential number identifying each vacuum load increment (test step) as printed in the report.
variables.evidence: Tables 1 and 2 (pp. 10-11) and Appendices A-D column 'test_no'
variables.name: Load increment (test) number

variables.definition: Approximate applied vacuum pressure at the load increment, taken from manometer readings.
variables.name: Applied vacuum load (manometer)
variables.note: Load values for the same test numbers differ slightly between Appendix A/C and Appendix B/D and Table 2; preserved verbatim in the source.

variables.definition: Applied uniform load back-calculated from the measured support load-cell reactions at each increment, including the value at the last recorded increment of each test.
variables.name: Load computed from load cells

variables.definition: Reaction measured by the load cell under one purlin at a typical exterior (end) support at each load increment.
variables.evidence: Table 1 'sensor_67_lb', Table 2 'sensor_50_lb', Appendix A 'sensor_67', Appendix C 'sensor_50'
variables.name: Exterior support reaction
variables.note: Sensor number is 67 in the Z test and 50 in the C test.

variables.definition: Reaction measured by the load cell under one purlin at a typical interior support at each load increment.
variables.evidence: Table 1 'sensor_68_lb', Table 2 'sensor_51_lb', Appendix A 'sensor_68', Appendix C 'sensor_51'
variables.name: Interior support reaction
variables.note: Sensor 68 values for Z tests 3 and 18 differ between Table 1 and Appendix A.

variables.definition: Ratio of the interior support reaction to the exterior support reaction at the same load increment, indicating degree of continuity/fixity.
variables.name: Interior/exterior reaction ratio
variables.note: Values of 3.00 (Z test 11) and 4.75/4.69 (C tests 57, 62) lie outside the expected 2.00-2.75 range and are preserved verbatim.

variables.definition: Strain measured by individual electrical resistance strain gages mounted on the purlin cross sections at each load increment (gage positions in Figs. 3 and 5).
variables.evidence: Appendix A columns sensor_1 to sensor_58 (pp. 51-56); Appendix C columns sensor_1 to sensor_40 and sensor_49 (pp. 61-68)
variables.name: Purlin strain gage reading
variables.note: Column numbering differs between tests: purlin gages are 1-58 in Appendix A and 1-40 plus 49 in Appendix C; several readings (e.g. sensor_5=915, sensor_8=1617-3009, sensor_23=-2531) are printed out of line and preserved verbatim, and some Appendix C sensor_12 values are illegible ([?]).

variables.definition: Strain measured by gages mounted on the top and bottom instrumented bracing straps at the supports at each load increment.
variables.evidence: Appendix A columns sensor_59 to sensor_66; Appendix C columns sensor_41 to sensor_48
variables.name: Bracing strap strain gage reading
variables.note: Appendix C sensor_47 reads 3966-3936 for tests 59-67, apparently off-scale; preserved verbatim.

variables.definition: Displacement measured by individual potentiometers mounted at upper/lower (or top/bottom) points on the purlins at each load increment.
variables.evidence: Appendix A columns sensor_69 to sensor_100 (Fig. 4); Appendix C columns sensor_52 to sensor_83 (Fig. 6)
variables.name: Potentiometer displacement
variables.note: Column numbers overlap between the two tests (e.g. sensor_52-58 are strain gages in Appendix A but potentiometers in Appendix C); mounting offsets A and B are given in Figs. 4 and 6.

variables.definition: Vertical deflection read optically (surveying instrument) at designated points on the purlins and deck at each load increment.
variables.evidence: Appendix A columns sensor_101 to sensor_108; Appendix C columns sensor_84 to sensor_90
variables.name: Optically read vertical deflection
variables.note: In Appendix A the final printed block is headed 103-108 but only five values per row are printed; sensor_108 is left empty and the column identity of the missing value is uncertain.

variables.definition: Numbers of the two paired potentiometers (upper/top and lower/bottom) whose readings were used to compute rotation and horizontal movement.
variables.evidence: Appendix B (pp. 58-59) and Appendix D (pp. 70-72) columns 'sensor_no_1' and 'sensor_no_2'
variables.name: Potentiometer pair numbers
variables.note: One block header is printed 'SENSOR NU.' instead of 'NO.'

variables.definition: Rotation of the purlin cross section at an instrumented point, computed from the difference of the paired potentiometer readings and their mounting offsets.
variables.evidence: Appendix B and Appendix D column 'angle_deg'
variables.name: Cross-section rotation angle
variables.note: Rows of all zeros at the highest loads indicate readings lost or not taken.

variables.definition: First component of the horizontal movement of the purlin cross section, derived from the paired potentiometer readings.
variables.evidence: Appendix B and Appendix D column 'horiz_move_1_in' under header 'HORRIZONTAL MOVEMENT (1)'
variables.name: Horizontal movement component 1

variables.definition: Second component of the horizontal movement of the purlin cross section, derived from the paired potentiometer readings.
variables.evidence: Appendix B and Appendix D column 'horiz_move_2_in' under header 'HORRIZONTAL MOVEMENT (2)'
variables.name: Horizontal movement component 2
variables.note: For sensor pair 76/77 at C test 61 the printed value +0.4090 is out of line with its neighbours.

variables.definition: Total horizontal movement of the cross section, printed as the sum of components (1) and (2).
variables.evidence: Appendix B and Appendix D column 'horiz_move_total_in'
variables.name: Total horizontal movement

variables.definition: Name of the full-scale system test (Z Purlin Test or C Purlin Test) as used in the report.
variables.name: Full-scale test identifier

variables.definition: Direction of the applied load on the roof assembly (gravity for both tests).
variables.name: Load direction

variables.definition: Shape of the purlin cross section used in the test assembly (C or Z).
variables.name: Purlin section shape

variables.definition: Nominal web depth of the purlin section (8 in. for the Z test, 7 in. for the C test).
variables.name: Purlin depth

variables.definition: Base steel thickness of the purlin material as printed in the report.
variables.evidence: Table S1 column 'thickness_in' and header note
variables.name: Purlin thickness
variables.note: C purlin exterior spans used 0.119 in. material and the interior span 0.0773 in.; both values are in one cell.

variables.definition: Individual span lengths between supports of the three-span continuous assembly.
variables.name: Span length
variables.note: Given as three span values per test in feet and inches.

variables.definition: Number of continuous spans in the tested purlin assembly (three in both tests).
variables.name: Number of spans

variables.definition: Number of parallel purlin lines loaded in the test assembly (two in both tests).
variables.name: Number of purlin lines

variables.definition: Description of the roof deck and its attachment to the purlins (through-fastened with No. 14 self-tapping screws).
variables.name: Roof panel/attachment type

variables.definition: Description of the bracing provided to the purlin flanges (instrumented steel straps at supports, no intermediate braces; rake channels in the C test only).
variables.name: Bracing arrangement

variables.definition: Maximum or failure applied vacuum load reached in the test exactly as printed in the report (58.12 psf for the Z test, 80 psf for the C test).
variables.name: Failure (maximum) applied load
variables.note: The report does not state whether specimen dead load is included.

variables.definition: Failure moment column provided in the summary table but left blank because the report reports no failure moments.
variables.name: Failure moment (not reported)
variables.note: No values reported in either test row.

variables.definition: Narrative description of what limited the strength of the assembly (deck buckling for the Z test, exterior-span purlin buckling for the C test).
variables.name: Failure mode

variables.definition: Note of where in the report the reported strength value is stated (table or text) and the PDF page(s).
variables.name: Source of strength value
variables.note: Bookkeeping fields rather than physical quantities.

variables.definition: Applied load at which buckling of the roof deck was first observed (33.36 psf for the Z test, 73.64 psf for the C test).
variables.name: Deck buckling onset load

variables.definition: Maximum tensile stress observed in the purlins during the test, computed from the strain gage readings.
variables.name: Maximum tensile stress

variables.definition: Maximum compressive stress observed in the purlins during the test, from the strain gage readings.
variables.evidence: Table S1 column 'max_compressive_stress_psi' and header note
variables.name: Maximum compressive stress
variables.note: For the Z test it is reported only as '50,000 psi or greater' at Sensors 5, 30, 34 and 56.

variables.definition: Manufacturer of the roof decking used in each test (Strand Steel for the Z test, Inland Ryerson for the C test).
variables.name: Deck manufacturer
